props.name: snap

props.doc: Accessible name.

props.doc: The context menu: true (default), false, or a function that gets the built-in items and returns the ones to show.

props.name: motion
props.doc: Draw-in of edges, moving dots, glow / shake / pop of nodes, the view and layout tweens (default true).

props.name: labels
props.type: { editor?: string; node?: string; menu?: string; minimap?: string; view?: string; zoomIn?: string; zoomOut?: string; fit?: string; layout?: string; copy?: string; cut?: string; duplicate?: string; group?: string; ungroup?: string; delete?: string; paste?: string; selectAll?: string; add?: ((type: string) => string) | undefined; input?: ((port: string) => string) | undefined; output?: ((port: string) => string) | undefined; connection?: ((from: string, to: string) => string) | undefined; values?: ((count: number) => string) | undefined; connected?: string; cannotConnect?: string; choosePort?: string; arranged?: ((count: number) => string) | undefined; copied?: ((count: number) => string) | undefined; pasted?: ((count: number) => string) | undefined; deleted?: ((count: number) => string) | undefined; selected?: ((count: number) => string) | undefined; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts; each falls back to the built-in one. Names: `editor` and `node` (role descriptions), `menu`, `minimap`, the zoom bar (`view`: its name, `zoomIn`, `zoomOut`, `fit`, `layout`), the menu items (`copy`, `cut`, `duplicate`, `group`, `ungroup`, `delete`, `paste`, `selectAll`, `add(type)`), ports and edges (`input(port)`, `output(port)`, `connection(from, to)`, `values(count)`) and what is announced (`connected`, `cannotConnect`, `choosePort`, `arranged(n)`, `copied(n)`, `pasted(n)`, `deleted(n)`, `selected(n)`).

hadi-march/flow#Minimap.name: Minimap

hadi-march/seo#tagKey.tr: Bir etiketin (öznitelikleri olarak) eşleştirildiği anahtar: burada yazılan etiketler ve HTML'de bulunanlar için aynı kurallar.

hadi-march/seo/hydrate#hydrate.name: hydrate
hadi-march/seo/hydrate#hydrate.doc: Take over prerendered HTML (data-m-prerender) without a flash, or render normally when there is none.
hadi-march/seo/hydrate#hydrate.signature: function hydrate(fn: () => unknown, el: Element, opts: HydrateOptions = {}): () => void
hadi-march/seo/hydrate#hydrate.tr: Önceden oluşturulmuş HTML'i (data-m-prerender) titremeden devralır; yoksa normal çizer.

hadi-march/seo/hydrate#HYDRATING_ATTR.name: HYDRATING_ATTR
hadi-march/seo/hydrate#HYDRATING_ATTR.doc: Set on <html> while hydrate() builds the app off-screen: what renders then is already on screen as prerendered HTML, so entrance animations (motion reveal) skip it and the swap shows no change. A DOM attribute, not an import: the motion code needs no dependency on this chunk.
hadi-march/seo/hydrate#HYDRATING_ATTR.tr: hydrate() uygulamayı ekran dışında kurarken <html> üzerinde duran öznitelik: giriş animasyonları ön işlenmiş içeriği yeniden oynatmaz.

hadi-march/seo/hydrate#prerenderedFor.name: prerenderedFor
hadi-march/seo/hydrate#prerenderedFor.doc: True when the URL shows the route prerendered into `el` (data-m-prerender: "#/x" for hash routing, else "/x"). History routing compares the path under the app's base (appBase()), so it works in any sub-folder. An address that names another route — an old hash link (#/x), the hash fallback, or the ?m-path= of a 404 fallback — never matches a path-prerendered page.
hadi-march/seo/hydrate#prerenderedFor.tr: URL, `el` içine önceden oluşturulmuş rotayı gösteriyorsa true (data-m-prerender: karma yönlendirmede "#/x", aksi halde "/x"). Geçmiş yönlendirmesi yolun sonunu karşılaştırır, böylece her tabanda çalışır; "/" yalnız klasör URL'sine uyar.

hadi-march/dom/sanitize#parseHtml.name: parseHtml
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#parseHtml.doc: Parse an HTML string into a fragment of allowlisted nodes. Inline styles are read only to keep emphasis that office suites encode as styles (font-weight, font-style, text-decoration); they are never copied.

hadi-march/dom/to-markdown#toMarkdown.name: toMarkdown
hadi-march/dom/to-markdown#toMarkdown.doc: Write a DOM tree (a root whose children are blocks: p, h1–h6, blockquote, ul / ol, pre, hr) as Markdown.
hadi-march/dom/to-markdown#toMarkdown.tr: Bir DOM ağacını (alt öğeleri blok olan bir kök: p, h1–h6, blockquote, ul / ol, pre, hr) Markdown olarak yazar.

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: applyDraft
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: Register a draft and switch the whole app to it (setColorTheme).
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: Bir taslağı kaydeder ve tüm uygulamayı ona geçirir (setColorTheme).

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: contrastAudit
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: WCAG checks of a mode: text pairs need 4.5:1, accents and indicators 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11); each failure gets a fix.
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: Bir kipin WCAG denetimleri: metin çiftleri 4,5:1, vurgular ve göstergeler 3:1 ister (WCAG 1.4.11); her hata için bir düzeltme önerilir.

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: decodeDraft
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: A draft from encodeDraft's code (null when it is not one).
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: encodeDraft kodundan taslak üretir (kod bir taslak değilse null).

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: deriveDark
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: A dark mode made from the light colors: a tinted dark canvas, readable text, the accents kept (lightened where needed).
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: Açık renklerden türetilen koyu kip: renk tonlu koyu zemin, okunur metin, korunan vurgular (gerekirse açılır).

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: draftCode
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: The defineTheme module of a draft: the definition, the build step that writes its CSS and the picker entry.
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: Bir taslağın defineTheme modülü: tanım, CSS'ini yazan derleme adımı ve seçici girdisi.

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: draftCss
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: The stylesheet of a draft (themeCss), with the draft encoded in a comment so the CSS can be imported back.
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: Bir taslağın stil dosyası (themeCss); taslak bir yorumda kodlanır, böylece CSS geri içe aktarılabilir.

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: draftFromColor
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: A new draft from one accent color: neutral surfaces tinted by it, standard status colors, a dark mode derived.
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.signature: function draftFromColor(seed: string, name: string = "My theme"): ThemeDraft
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: Tek bir vurgu renginden yeni taslak: o renkle tonlanmış nötr yüzeyler, standart durum renkleri, türetilmiş koyu kip.

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: draftFromTheme
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: A draft of a theme definition (a built-in preset or your own).
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: Bir tema tanımının (yerleşik bir hazır tema ya da sizinki) taslağı.

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: draftJson
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: The draft as JSON.
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: Taslağı JSON olarak verir.

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: draftTokens
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: The extra tokens of a draft (ThemeDef.tokens): type sizes, line heights, weights, mono font, radius steps, spacing, control heights, shadows, border width, durations, easings and the primary tone scale. `all` also writes the ones equal to the built-in values (a scoped preview needs them all).
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.signature: function draftTokens(d: ThemeDraft, all: boolean = false): Record<string, string>
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: Bir taslağın ek belirteçleri (ThemeDef.tokens): yazı boyutları, satır yükseklikleri, kalınlıklar, mono yazı tipi, köşe yarıçapı adımları, boşluklar, denetim yükseklikleri, gölgeler, kenarlık kalınlığı, süreler, yumuşatmalar ve birincil ton ölçeği.

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: draftToTheme
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: The ThemeDef of a draft (defineTheme-checked): colors, fonts, radius and the extra tokens.
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.signature: function draftToTheme(d: ThemeDraft, allTokens: boolean = false): ThemeDef
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: Bir taslağın ThemeDef'i (defineTheme ile denetlenmiş): renkler, yazı tipleri, köşe yarıçapı ve ek belirteçler.

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: draftVars
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: The CSS variables of a draft for one mode, exactly as its stylesheet sets them (themeCss), all tokens included.
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.signature: function draftVars(d: ThemeDraft, mode: DraftMode): Record<string, string>
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: Bir taslağın tek kip için CSS değişkenleri; stil dosyasının (themeCss) ayarladığı biçimde, tüm belirteçlerle.

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: encodeDraft
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: A draft as a URL-safe code (share links, the CSS comment).
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: Bir taslağı URL'ye uygun bir koda çevirir (paylaşım bağlantıları, CSS yorumu).

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: importTheme
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: Import pasted text: a draft (JSON), a ThemeDef (JSON), a share link or code, or a theme stylesheet (themeCss / ThemeEditor CSS).
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: Yapıştırılan metni içe aktarır: taslak (JSON), ThemeDef (JSON), paylaşım bağlantısı ya da kodu, ya da tema stil dosyası (themeCss / ThemeEditor CSS'i).

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: normalizeDraft
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: A complete, valid draft from loose data (missing or wrong fields take `base`'s values); null when not a draft.
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.signature: function normalizeDraft(v: unknown, base: ThemeDraft = draftFromColor("#f2801f")): ThemeDraft | null
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: Gevşek veriden eksiksiz ve geçerli bir taslak üretir (eksik ya da hatalı alanlar `base` değerlerini alır); taslak değilse null.

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: presetCopy
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: A draft of a built-in preset with an id and name of its own ("my-night", "Night Blue (copy)"): a runtime theme never takes a built-in id.
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: Yerleşik bir hazır temanın, kendi kimliği ve adı olan taslağı ("my-night", "Night Blue (copy)"): çalışma anı teması hiçbir zaman yerleşik bir kimlik almaz.

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: presetDraft
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: A draft of a built-in preset by id (HADİ when unknown).
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: Kimliğiyle yerleşik bir hazır temanın taslağı (bilinmiyorsa HADİ).

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: PRESETS
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: The built-in presets (HADİ, Classic Cream, Night Blue, Neon, Indigo, Minimal, High Contrast).
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: Yerleşik hazır temalar (HADİ, Classic Cream, Night Blue, Neon, Indigo, Minimal, High Contrast).

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: registerDraft
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: Offer a draft in ThemePicker / ThemeMenu as a theme of its own (no stylesheet needed); calling again updates it.
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: Bir taslağı ThemePicker / ThemeMenu içinde ayrı bir tema olarak sunar (stil dosyası gerekmez); yeniden çağırmak onu günceller.

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: sharedDraft
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: The draft in a share link (null when the link has none).
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.signature: function sharedDraft(href: string = globalThis.location?.href ?? ""): ThemeDraft | null
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: Paylaşım bağlantısındaki taslak (bağlantıda yoksa null).

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: shareUrl
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: A link to `href` that opens the draft in a ThemeEditor (`?theme=<code>`; a hash route stays as it is).
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.signature: function shareUrl(d: ThemeDraft, href: string = globalThis.location?.href ?? "http://localhost/"): string
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: `href` adresine, taslağı bir ThemeEditor'da açan bağlantı (`?theme=<code>`; hash rotası olduğu gibi kalır).

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: ThemeEditor
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: Theme editor: `<ThemeEditor />`, `<ThemeEditor bind:value={$draft} base="night" storageKey={false} />` (its body loads as a chunk).

props.name: value
props.doc: The draft (`bind:value` works); default: a share link in the URL, the saved draft, then `base`.

props.name: base
props.doc: Preset to start from when there is no value (default "hadi"); "scratch" starts from one accent color.

props.name: tabs
props.doc: Tabs shown (default all).

props.name: preview
props.doc: Live preview beside the controls (default true).

props.name: storageKey
props.doc: Save under this StorageManager key (default "theme-editor"); false: no saving.

props.name: share
props.doc: Read a share link (`?theme=…`) on start (default true).

props.name: warnUnsaved
props.doc: Warn before leaving with unsaved changes (default true).

props.name: onSave
props.doc: Called with the theme when it is saved.

props.name: presets
props.doc: The "Start from" row of base themes (default true).

props.name: nameField
props.doc: The theme name field with its id line (default true).

props.name: historyButtons
props.doc: The undo / redo buttons (default true; Ctrl+Z still works).

props.name: applyButton
props.doc: The "Apply to the app" button (default true).

props.name: previewControls
props.doc: The light / dark, LTR / RTL and reduced-motion switches above the preview (default true).

props.name: labels
props.type: { editor?: string; name?: string; undo?: string; redo?: string; unsaved?: string; saved?: string; save?: string; apply?: string; applied?: string; startFrom?: string; scratch?: string; sections?: string; tabs?: Partial<Record<ThemeEditorTab, string>>; preview?: string; previewMode?: string; light?: string; dark?: string; previewDirection?: string; reducedMotion?: string; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts of the editor frame (defaults: the translated ones). The texts inside the tabs follow the locale pack: change them with `messages(locale, { "English text": "yours" })`.

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: Tema düzenleyici: `<ThemeEditor />`, `<ThemeEditor bind:value={$draft} base="night" storageKey={false} />` (gövdesi ayrı bir parça olarak yüklenir).

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: toneScale
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: A 10-step tone scale of a color: tints toward white below 500, shades toward black above.
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.signature: function toneScale(color: string): { step: number; color: string }[]
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: Bir rengin 10 adımlı ton ölçeği: 500'ün altında beyaza doğru açılır, üstünde siyaha doğru koyulaşır.

hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.name: typeScale
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.doc: Type sizes of a draft in px (2xs … 5xl): base × ratio^step, steps fitted so ratio 1.2 gives the built-in scale.
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.signature: function typeScale(t: Pick<DraftType, "base" | "ratio">): { name: string; px: number }[]
hadi-march/components/composite/theme-ed.tr: Bir taslağın px cinsinden yazı boyutları (2xs … 5xl): taban × oran^adım; adımlar, 1,2 oranı yerleşik ölçeği verecek biçimde ayarlıdır.

hadi-march/components/data/data-grid#Dat.name: DataGrid
hadi-march/components/data/data-grid#Dat.doc: `<DataGrid rows={rows} columns={[{ key: "amount", aggregate: "sum" }]} groupBy={["region"]} selectable />`

props.name: rows
props.doc: Rows (array, signal or getter). Ignored when `table` is given.

props.name: table
props.doc: Use an existing createTable() state (server data, saved views, URL sync …).

props.name: height
props.doc: Px height of the scroll area (default 480).

props.name: rowHeight
props.doc: Row height in px (default 36).

props.name: groupBy
props.doc: Column keys to group by (controlled when you also pass onGroupBy).

props.name: selectable
props.doc: Row checkboxes, Space / Shift+arrows / Ctrl+click selection.

props.name: onEdit
props.doc: Save an edited cell (columns with `editable: true`). Throw to show the message.

props.name: footer
props.doc: Totals row with each column's aggregate over all filtered rows (default: when a column has `aggregate`).

props.name: toolbar
props.doc: Toolbar with search, grouping, filters, CSV and the row count (default true); an object turns single tools off: `{ csv: false }`.

props.name: columnMenu
props.doc: The ⋮ menu of every column header (default true).

props.name: empty
props.doc: The empty state: true (default: the text in `labels`), false, or your own node.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Your own texts (see DataGridLabels).

props.name: animate
props.doc: Row entrance, column slide and save flash (default true).

props.name: filename
props.doc: CSV file name (without .csv).

props.name: onActivate
props.doc: Enter / double-click on a non-editable cell.

hadi-march/components/data/data-grid#Dat.tr: Gruplama, toplam satırları ve seçim içeren veri ızgarası: `<DataGrid rows={rows} columns={[{ key: "amount", aggregate: "sum" }]} groupBy={["region"]} selectable />`

hadi-march/components/data/gantt#Gantt.name: Gantt

props.name: onChange
props.doc: After a move, resize or progress change (and once per task pushed by `cascade`); the chart already shows it.

props.name: cascade
props.doc: Push successors later when a predecessor would overlap them (default true).

props.name: arrows
props.doc: Show the dependency arrows (default true).

props.name: height
props.doc: Px height of the chart (default 420).

props.name: todayLine
props.doc: The today line and its label (default true).

props.name: names
props.doc: The pinned column of task names (default true).

props.name: help
props.doc: The hint under the chart: true (default: the text in `labels`), false, or your own node.

props.name: barLabel
props.doc: Content of a bar: `(task) => node` (default: the task name).

props.name: labels
props.doc: Your own texts: `{ today, task, days, help, helpReadonly, done, after, moved, pushed }`.

props.name: animate
props.doc: Arrow drawing, settle and scale-change animations (default true).

hadi-march/components/data/gantt#Gantt.tr: Görevleri zaman ekseninde çubuklarla gösteren Gantt şeması: `<Gantt tasks={$tasks} scale="week" onChange={(task) => save(task)} />`

hadi-march/components/data/scheduler#Sch.name: Scheduler
hadi-march/components/data/scheduler#Sch.doc: `<Scheduler events={$events} view="week" onChange={(ev, r) => save(ev.id, r)} onCreate={(r) => add(r)} />`

props.name: date
props.doc: The date in view (ISO).

props.name: onChange
props.doc: After a drag (move / resize) or a keyboard move; the calendar already shows it.

props.name: onCreate
props.doc: Drag on an empty slot (or click a free day in month view).

props.name: onSelect
props.doc: Click / Enter on an event.

props.name: step
props.doc: Snap in minutes (default 15).

props.name: hourHeight
props.doc: Px per hour in week / day view (default 48).

props.name: startHour
props.doc: Hour scrolled into view first (default 8).

props.name: weekends
props.doc: Show Saturday and Sunday in week view (default true).

props.name: editable
props.doc: Drag, resize and create (default true).

props.name: height
props.doc: Px height of the calendar body (default 600).

props.name: locale
props.doc: Date locale (default: the app locale). Names, first day of week, 12 / 24 h and direction follow it.

props.name: toolbar
props.doc: The bar above the calendar: period buttons, title and view switch (default true).

props.name: views
props.doc: Views offered by the view switch (default all three); false or a single view hides the switch.

props.name: todayButton
props.doc: The "Today" button (default true).

props.name: nowLine
props.doc: The line at the current time in week / day view (default true).

props.name: help
props.doc: The hint under the calendar: true (default: the text in `labels`), false, or your own node.

props.name: renderEvent
props.type: ((event: SchedulerEvent, info: { view: SchedulerView; time: string }) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: Content of an event: `(event, { view, time }) => node` (default: title, time and place).

props.name: labels
props.doc: Your own texts (see SchedulerLabels).

props.name: animate
props.doc: Slide, view-change and settle animations (default true).

hadi-march/components/data/scheduler#Sch.tr: Etkinliklerin taşınıp oluşturulabildiği takvim: `<Scheduler events={$events} view="week" onChange={(ev, r) => save(ev.id, r)} onCreate={(r) => add(r)} />`

hadi-march/components/data/tree-view#Tre.name: TreeView
hadi-march/components/data/tree-view#Tre.doc: `<TreeView nodes={files} load={(n) => api.children(n.id)} selection="multiple" search={$q} draggable />`

props.name: load
props.doc: Children of a `lazy` node (called once per node; a rejection shows a retry row).

props.name: selected
props.doc: Initially selected ids.

props.name: expanded
props.doc: Initially open ids.

props.name: search
props.doc: Search text: shows the hits and the path to them, highlighted.

props.name: draggable
props.doc: Drag and drop to reorder / reparent (Alt+↑ / Alt+↓ moves among siblings from the keyboard).

props.name: canDrop
props.type: ((ids: string[], target: TreeViewNode, position: DropPosition) => boolean) | undefined

props.name: onMove
props.type: ((ids: string[], targetId: string, position: DropPosition) => void) | undefined
props.doc: After a move; the tree already shows it (pass `nodes` as an accessor to own the data instead).

props.name: onActivate
props.doc: Enter / double-click on a leaf.

props.name: height
props.doc: Px height of the scroll area (default 360).

props.name: icons
props.doc: Folder / file icons when a node has none (default true).

props.name: chevron
props.type: boolean | ((node: TreeViewNode, open: boolean) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: The open / close arrow: true (default), false (rows still open with a double click and the keyboard), or `(node, open) => node`.

props.name: empty
props.doc: The empty state: true (default: the text in `labels`), false, or your own node.

props.name: ghost
props.doc: Content of the drag ghost: `(nodes) => node` (default: the first label and a count).

props.name: labels
props.doc: Your own texts: `{ loading, retry, empty, noMatch }`.

props.name: animate
props.doc: Opening, landing and ghost animations (default true).

props.name: color
props.doc: Colour of selected rows (theme token; default: the accent).

hadi-march/components/data/tree-view#Tre.tr: Tembel yükleme, çoklu seçim, arama ve sürüklemeyle büyük ağaç görünümü: `<TreeView nodes={files} load={(n) => api.children(n.id)} selection="multiple" search={$q} draggable />`
